checks.q: Is the VAA (Verified Action Approval) signature threshold correctly validated?
Are guardian set updates properly verified against the current set?
Is VAA replay prevented with proper nonce/hash tracking?
Are emitter addresses verified per chain?
Is the consistency level appropriate for the security requirement?
Are token transfer amounts correctly converted between chains?
Is the relayer integration protected against fee extraction?
Are governance VAAs (contract upgrades) properly gated?
Is the integration tested against Wormhole's testnet with real guardian behavior?
Are batch VAA operations handled atomically?
